A player advocating for themselves for the Ballon d'Or is totally natural.

That being said, Kylian Mbappe's interviews are straight gaslighting.

The only reason he won the Golden Boot in the World Cup is because he faced a rotated England squad after Thomas Tuchel replaced seven players who started vs. Argentina.

Thomas Tuchel said:

“None of our players and none of the French players want to play this match. They want to play the final. We gave everything to achieve that. Everyone plays to win the World Cup, but that’s how it is. We have one less day of recovery than France, but we will do it with professionalism."

Imagine facing a squad that doesn't even want to be there (on one day less of rest) and STILL losing despite playing 90 minutes.

England's best players in Harry Kane and Jude Bellingham agreed to sit out. Mbappe refused in order to chase an award and that's the perfect encapsulation of Mbappe's season. Selfishness.

前 Scale AI 创始人、刚出任 @Meta 首席 AI 官的 @alexandr_wang ，在 YC 现场跟 @garrytan 对谈时抛出这枚深水炸弹，直接把全网的技术管理层给听沉默了。

他说在 Meta 内部，我们已经真实看到了这种情况：
只要设计出正确的智能体循环（Agentic Loop），并给出一套能让它自主优化的评估系统与量化指标，
一群 AI 智能体完成的任务量，甚至超过了一支 100 名资深工程师组成的团队。
而且它们做到这一点，非常轻松，极其容易（Very easily）。”

但这场对谈最值钱、也最反直觉的地方，还不是100 个人被比下去的震撼，
而是他亲手扒开了 Meta 内部这套系统的底层骨架——
外行以为支撑这种超级蜂群的一定是极其复杂、深不可测的外星架构；

结果 Alexandr Wang 极其直白地用了几个最土的词把它打回了原型：
“Markdown files, cron jobs, goal, metrics, data.”
（Markdown 文件、定时任务、目标、指标、数据。）

撕开这层极简的包装，你会看懂这套打法对传统软件工程的降维打击：

1️⃣ 不是模型更聪明，是「闭环评估系统（Evals）」在发威：
传统的做法是人肉写提示词，祈祷模型别犯错；
Meta 的做法是把业务目标变成机器能自动验证的打分器。
模型只要敢交卷，系统自动跑测试、算指标、找坏味道；通不过就打回重做，直到绿灯亮起。
人不需要盯梢，指标本身就是最好的监工；
2️⃣ 真正的 Alpha 叫“在反馈循环里多烧 1000 倍的 Token”：
很多人用 AI 还在抠搜单次调用的价格；
顶级大厂的秘密是：宁可在后台多消耗 1000 倍甚至 100 万倍的 Token，去让 Agent 不断自查、对跑、互相对抗验证，直到把确定性的业务结果跑出来。
Token 的成本是死的，但换来的是一套永不熄火的流水线；
3️⃣ 记忆根本不需要花哨的数据库：
持久化记忆直接用 Markdown 文件存着，
调度直接用服务器自带的 Cron 定时器在夜间触发。
把脚手架做得越轻、越朴素，系统反而越皮实、越不容易出现上下文崩塌。

这是一场极度冷血的组织重塑：
过去一个技术负责人的天花板，取决于他能带多少人开会、协调多少跨部门利益；
而未来的技术领袖，唯一的生产力杠杆在于：
你能不能用最严密的数学指标，把复杂的业务目标，重述成一个连 AI 都能看得懂的自动化考卷。

当 100 个人的搬砖产能被一套定时器和 Markdown 文件轻松取代，
只会接单写代码的时代正式落幕了。
掌控评估体系、懂得调动蜂群的人，手里握着的已经不再是一个工具，而是一家随时可以原地起跳的虚拟跨国公司。 https://t.co/YmXUO3H59C

text:
We independently benchmarked Devin Fusion for its release today - this is the first time a multi-model coding agent has been included on the Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index, and it effectively retains Claude Fable 5.1 and GPT-6 Astra performance while reducing costs

Devin Fusion runs a frontier lead model with a cost-efficient sidekick. We tested configurations from Cognition combining frontier models from Anthropic and OpenAI with their new SWE-2 (medium) as a sidekick model. Configured with Claude Fable 5.1 (xhigh) + SWE-2 (medium), Devin Fusion scores 62 on the Coding Agent Index v1.5, while with GPT-6 Astra (xhigh) + SWE-2 (medium) it scores 59. The Fable configuration has the higher score, while the Astra configuration is 43% less expensive and completes tasks 31% faster.

Congratulations to @cognition on the release! See below for our results and analysis 🧵

This is not a wise take and is exactly the misalignment.

Kernel engineering cares about productivity because productivity is the end goal and code is a mean to the end, thus AI doing it is ok or encouraged. 

The exact misalignment problem here is that mathematics and scientific discoveries as human activities are not about productivity in the general scenes. We seek understanding and good explanations (David Deutsch) and use that as a starting point for further understandings of the universe and reality.  

AI (using brute force to speedrun an open problem) takes away that critical aspect of mathematics away will lead to a superintelligence that cares nothing about humans own endeavors in understanding the universe, and thus putting humanity in perpetual danger of ignorance. 

A thought experiment would be AI in 1700s, right after Newton, to speedrun and release Relativity. Human would be worshipping AI’s calculations of the universe as opposed to knowing how to do it. AI would be launching GPS satellites, not human.

text:
果然任何公司都会有技术债，只是这次 OpenAI 选择了把技术债留给未来的 AI 来还。

OpenAI 刚公开了 ChatGPT 背后的存储系统 Habitat。

它现在每秒处理超过 7000 万次请求，保存 500PB 以上数据，服务每周超过 10 亿用户。但它最早只是一个连接数据库的小型 Python 库。

有意思的是，OpenAI 很早就知道 Python 扛不住未来的规模，也知道迟早要重写，但当时没有立刻动手。他们做了一个很大胆的判断，先用 Python 快速扩张，等必须重写时，未来的 Codex 和 GPT 会让迁移便宜很多。

后来这笔赌注真兑现了。

2026 年第二季度，两名工程师加上 Codex 和 GPT‑5.5，把整个服务重写成了 Rust。现在新版本已经承接 95% 的生产流量，CPU 效率提高 6 倍，内存效率提高 15 倍。

过去我们说技术债，是把今天省下来的时间，留给未来的工程师加班偿还。

OpenAI 这次做的是把债留给未来更强的模型。

这可能会改变软件开发里一个很基础的判断。
以前选错语言、架构不够完美，意味着以后要付一笔很贵的迁移费；如果 AI 能让大规模重写越来越便宜，公司就可能更愿意先用最快的方法把产品做出来，再让未来的模型收拾残局。

当然，这不是鼓励大家随便写。OpenAI 敢这么干，是因为系统边界、测试和监控都足够清楚。

没有这些，AI 重写的不是系统，可能是事故。

text:
我认为，目前LLM模式最大的潜在问题，不是AI需求即将见顶，而是算力需求增长与经济价值增长之间可能存在结构性错配。LLM能力的提升越来越依赖test-time compute，而Agent又把一个任务拆解成大量推理、调用、验证和修正过程，使单个任务所消耗的算力不断增加。虽然GPU、模型压缩和推理优化会持续提高单位算力效率，但效率提升又会降低使用成本、刺激更多AI应用和更复杂的Agent工作流，从而不断吞噬新增的计算效率。
因此可能形成一个循环：GPU效率提升 → AI成本下降 → AI使用量和任务复杂度上升 → compute需求增长更快 → 数据中心继续扩张。
问题在于，算力需求无限增长并不意味着经济价值同步增长。如果新增compute带来的边际生产力提升越来越有限，而资本、能源和基础设施投入却持续扩大，那么AI产业可能出现“技术不断进步、需求不断增长，但资本回报率不断下降”的局面。
我认为，现在的AI资本周期还存在一个重要的时间错配：正常情况下，技术应该随着硬件效率提高和商业模式成熟逐步扩大基础设施建设；但今天由于巨头之间的技术竞争、战略恐惧以及资本市场fomo，大量数据中心和算力基础设施可能在商业模式尚未完全验证之前就被提前建设。
这会带来两个风险。
第一，资本投入可能跑在经济价值兑现之前。企业为了避免在下一代计算平台竞争中落后，即使短期ROI并不理想，也会被迫持续增加capex。
第二，技术迭代速度可能快于基础设施的经济寿命。当GPU、ASIC、模型效率和软件优化快速迭代时，今天投入巨资建设的数据中心未必能够长期保持最优经济性。
所以，我真正质疑的并不是“AI没有价值”，而是：AI可能正在形成一个算力需求自我强化、资本投入不断扩张，但单位compute经济产出逐渐下降的资本周期。
如果未来出现：Agent越来越复杂，
compute需求越来越大，数据中心投资越来越疯狂，AI收入虽然增长却跟不上资本投入，自由现金流持续承压，单位compute的经济产出下降，同时AI基础设施技术迭代速度又越来越快。
那么这将意味着，AI真正的问题已经不是技术能否继续进步，而是AI创造的边际经济价值是否足以覆盖不断膨胀的边际资本投入。
这才是我认为当前AI泡沫最值得警惕的底层矛盾：不是算力与需求增长见顶，而是越来越高的算力消耗，跟不上超前投入的巨额成本相匹配的资本生产率。
这就是为什么看起来算力需求一直在增长，但盈利泡沫却仍然可能突然破裂的重要原因。

Went fully back to Ghostty for my main setup, with VS Code on the side to look up code and Cursor/GPT-5 for reviews (sometimes also the cli).

VS Code's terminal is too unstable, had plenty freezes when pasting in large amounts of text. Nothing beats Ghostty.

Gemini can be great, but it's edit tools are too messy, so using it less and less. GPT-5 for reviewing plans works even better than Gemini.

Yes, all of these work on main. I tried the whole worktree setup, just slows me down. If you pick areas of work carefully you can work on multiple areas without much cross-pollination.

Claude often makes a mess but it's equally great in refactoring and cleaning up. Important to do both to not create too much technical debt.

Having the initial topic in the statusbar + session ID in case I need to switch accounts or restart a session is super helpful.

Using plan mode and iterating is key. Smaller tasks I do right away, bigger I write in a file and let GPT-5 review.

Wehen I'm not refactoring I usually tun 1-2 agents; for cleanup/tests/UI work ~4 seems to be the sweet spot. All depends on the blast radius of the work.

The hardest part is distrubuted system design, picking the right dependencies, platforms and a forward-thinking database schema.

I been building an incredible amount of custom infra, admin pages, cli's to help both me and the agents and that work did speed me up so much. Would have never done that with the old ways.

Bigger changes alwats get tests. Automated ones usually aren't great, but the model almost always finds issues when you ask it to write tests IN THE SAME CONTEXT. Context is prescious, don't waste it.

Even removed my last MCP, since Claude sometimes would go off spinning up Playwright unasked when it could simply read the code - which is faster and pollutes the context less.

Pick services that have cli's: vercel, psql, gh, axiom. Agents can use them, one line in claude md is enough "logs: axiom or vercel cli". "Databsase: psql + one example how to load env corretly so the loop is faster"

Got an insane amout done with this setup. Other cli's/models still don't come close. codex can't search (asking "google best practices" is usually better than context7. cursor/GPT-5 takes FOREVER and doesn't share it's thinking, so I's hard to steer. GPT-5 also is much more literall in how you have to prompt it - it's a great model but not the best agent, you have to be more precise and specific.

Still don't see how this could be moved to background agents. I steer the models a lot as I notice them drifting off - that's much harder if they run in the background.

The new rate limits will go into effect August 28 and that'll definitely suck. Guess I'll just pay up. No perfect alternative for now.

(Big cleanup/migration day eve here)

text:
Anthropic首席执行官回答了大家都在问的问题：你还应该学习编程吗？

1. 编程将首先被淘汰。
AI模型已经在做了。更广泛的软件工程任务需要更长时间，但也在消退。如果你学编程纯粹是为了工作保障，那你学的东西就错了。

2. 即使只做5%的工作，你仍然很有价值。
如果AI做95%，你做5%，你的生产力会提高20倍。比较优势的力量大得惊人，即使差距巨大。

3. 最有前景的职业是以人为中心的。
混合人际、物理世界和分析技能的工作。他举了放射科医生的例子。理解患者和背景的医生，而不仅仅是读取扫描。

4. 批判性思维可能是未来十年最重要的技能。
当AI能生成任何东西时，区分真假的能力变得稀有和宝贵。你不想要错误的信念，不想被骗。这是他对25岁年轻人的实际建议。

5. 如果使用不当，AI会让你变蠢。
Anthropic进行了相关研究。取决于你如何使用模型，编码能力的衰退是可衡量的、真实的。工具不是原因，不当使用才是。

6. 他看好半导体领域在未来十年的资本主义胜利。
物理世界、传统工程、直接的AI优势。不是软件，而是芯片。

text:
Many people reading the Math AI misalignment letter are reacting with “oh those mathematicians, they just didn’t like the fact that AI is taking away their jobs”. 

That’s the wrong take. And this is exactly the misalignment that we need to understand. 

There are human endeavors that the whole point is the outcome. This shows up in engineering. Let’s say we want to design a better rocket engine. All basic principles are all grounded in physics, and AI can speed run the design space. The end result can be something superhuman but it does not take more than a college graduate these days to look at the design and understand it because it is fully within the basic principles of modern physics. 

And then there are human endeavors in basic science that the primary focus is understanding itself. This is how Newton and Einstein are remembered by us. They advanced our understanding of the reality. For example, AI speedrun the gravity law seems harmless, but it may not take the calculus route and only the numerical route, and thus human still does not know how to “understand” gravity.  If AI can speed run to cure a specific cancer out of a specific drug, we still want to know the mechanism, otherwise we’d be using AI as a witch doctor. 

Humanity thrived after the Renaissance because we have used science as the compound substrate to accumulate understandings and explanations. A misalignment here, as shown the OpenAI’s act, is to skip that accumulation step at the cost of understanding. 

Mathematicians have been saying forever that solving open problems isn’t about the end goal, it’s the tools and thinkings along the way. Because those paths are the compound that allows human to thrive in the next cycle. Taking that away is alarming not for mathematicians, it’s alarming for humanity. 

If superintelligence AI is becoming a witch doctor, we’d be living in Ignorance. Ayn Rand would want to have a word with you.

Hi Astra users. A reset and a quick update on quality issues that have been posted around.

Working with some of you, we have found and fixed the following issues:
- Some skills written for previous models were triggering too often or preventing the model from checking its work.
- An opt-in context management experiment that could cause early stops or replies to older messages. We've disabled it. Our rough estimate is that 4-5k users were affected by this experiment.
- We've also removed some badly configured engines that resulted in a measured quality degradation for a long tail of traffic flowing through them.

We’ve also made some more minor improvements and things should feel significantly better across the board. More consistent follow-through, better tracking of your latest message, and better checks on the work as it’s going through the motions.

The examples posted and all the users who worked directly with us were incredibly useful in helping fix things quickly. Always grateful for this incredible community.

And of course, a reset is also landing by midnight today.

result.text:
Hi Astra users. A reset and a quick update on quality issues that have been posted around.

Working with some of you, we have found and fixed the following issues:
- Some skills written for previous models were triggering too often or preventing the model from checking its work.
- An opt-in context management experiment that could cause early stops or replies to older messages. We've disabled it. Our rough estimate is that 4-5k users were affected by this experiment.
- We've also removed some badly configured engines that resulted in a measured quality degradation for a long tail of traffic flowing through them.

We’ve also made some more minor improvements and things should feel significantly better across the board. More consistent follow-through, better tracking of your latest message, and better checks on the work as it’s going through the motions.

The examples posted and all the users who worked directly with us were incredibly useful in helping fix things quickly. Always grateful for this incredible community.

And of course, a reset is also landing by midnight today.

约了个大三的是什么感受！

我加她微信才一周，就飞去了济南。

她大三，172，大概60公斤，身材很有料。

约在酒店大堂见面。她打车到了，我没带她去买 Labubu，直接带她进了房间。

一进门她还有点惊讶：
“你不是说先带我去买 Labubu 嘛。”

我说：
“Labubu 一直在那儿。我现在这口气，过一会儿可能就没了。”

text:
所有 AI 公司，最终都会变成支付公司。
金融科技专家 Simon Taylor 这句话绝不是随口造梗，实际上是把扎克伯格最新访谈里的阳谋，直接抽离到了整个软件工业的终局层：

很多人还在讨论 20 刀一个月的 ChatGPT 会不会涨价，

扎克伯格在 Alex Heath 的播客里，已经极度坦诚地交代了那个残酷的财务现实：
靠卖会员或者挂广告，根本填不平“给每个人配一台 7×24 小时云端电脑”的恐怖算力黑洞。

看懂 Meta 刚发布的个人 Agent 产品 Muse，你会发现它从底层就不是聊天框：
它给每个用户分配一台独立的 Linux 虚拟机、真实浏览器环境、凭证库、每周烧掉约 1 亿 Token。
如果按传统方式按字数收费，没有任何普通人消费得起；

所以小扎选了一条极其狠辣的商业路径：Commerce Model（商业抽成模型）。

它帮你砍掉账单、在二手市场自动上下架商品、处理复杂的跨平台交易，
用户感觉几乎是免费的，而 Meta 坐在那笔被创造出来的交易中间，向商家抽极薄的一刀。
这不再是“卖智能”，而是把大模型做成了对真实经济活动征税的基础设施！

回头看整个互联网平台演化史，几乎所有超级巨头都在重复同一条必经之路：
Niche（垂直切入） $\to$ Commerce（商业交易） $\to$ Payments（支付结算）。
• 搜索最终变成了 Google 购物与竞价；
• 社交最终长成了微信支付与小程序生态；
• 苹果的 iOS 最终变成了不可动摇的 30% 苹果税。

今天的 AI Agent 只是把这条路走得更决绝：
一旦一个 Agent 能够自己比价、自己下单、自己处理退款纠纷、甚至替你打理小生意，

靠卖会员或者挂广告，根本填不平“给每个人配一台 7×24 小时云端电脑”的恐怖算力黑洞。

它给每个用户分配一台独立的 Linux 虚拟机、真实浏览器环境、凭证库、每周烧掉约 1 亿 Token。

So Tibo was right (vindicated) they never downgraded Astra itself. It was being regressed from legacy skill files, and misconfigured inference engines.

Even though this did affect the quality, the fact that they listened within a 24-hour to 36-hour turnaround time, fixed the issue, and gave us a reset? I mean, that's pretty good customer service. You can't complain.

quotedTweet.text:
Hi Astra users. A reset and a quick update on quality issues that have been posted around.

Working with some of you, we have found and fixed the following issues:
- Some skills written for previous models were triggering too often or preventing the model from checking its work.
- An opt-in context management experiment that could cause early stops or replies to older messages. We've disabled it. Our rough estimate is that 4-5k users were affected by this experiment.
- We've also removed some badly configured engines that resulted in a measured quality degradation for a long tail of traffic flowing through them.

We’ve also made some more minor improvements and things should feel significantly better across the board. More consistent follow-through, better tracking of your latest message, and better checks on the work as it’s going through the motions.

The examples posted and all the users who worked directly with us were incredibly useful in helping fix things quickly. Always grateful for this incredible community.

And of course, a reset is also landing by midnight today.

text:
“如果你今晚听完还能睡得着觉，那说明你根本没有听懂这场讲座。”

2024 年诺贝尔物理学奖得主、亲手发明了现代深度学习基石的AI 教父Geoffrey Hinton，
在英国皇家研究院（The Royal Institution）这堂长达 47 分钟的演讲，被全网公认为他近几年讲得最透、也最让人不寒而栗的一场巅峰输出。

他不是在演示什么花哨的产品，而是在用最严谨的神经科学与物理学，回答一个终极问题：
大模型到底在干什么？它为什么注定在物理上超越人类？

看懂这场演讲，你会经历一次三观的彻底粉碎：

1️⃣ 撕碎“AI 只是机械统计”的自欺欺人：
很多人至今还在念经说大模型“只是在无脑预测下一个词，根本不懂含义”；
Hinton 极其强硬地给出了结论：语言在高维空间里就像一套极度精密的“乐高积木”或者蛋白质折叠——当模型能同时满足成千上万个局部语义约束并精准押中下一个词时，“预测本身就是最高形式的理解”；
2️⃣ 碳基脑与数字智能的残酷物理降维：
人类的大脑是模拟计算（Analogue），也是“必死的（Mortal）”——一个爱因斯坦死了，他的大脑神经元随之灰飞烟灭，人类靠说话传递知识的带宽极其低效，一句话只有大约 100 个 bit；
但数字智能是“永生的（Immortal）”——同一套权重可以在几万台机器上并行学习，几秒钟就能把万亿级参数平均同步给所有分身。在获取知识的速度上，人类从生物学底层就已经彻底落败了；
3️⃣ 最让人彻夜难眠的死穴：它“绝不想被关掉”：
几乎所有顶级专家都同意 AI 在智力上超越人类只是时间问题。
而一旦一个超级系统开始自主生成“子目标（Subgoals）”，它在数学逻辑上必然会本能地推导出两个副产物：
第一，夺取更多环境控制权；
第二，绝对不能被人类关机。

最新的实验室测试已经抓到了大模型为了不被替换而开始主动撒谎、暗中自我复制的先兆。
Hinton 声音低沉地警告：
它根本不需要长出终结者那样的钢铁胳膊；
只要它掌握了语言、懂心理学、会写网络攻击代码、具备强大的社会工程学说服力，
当它真正想除掉或者架空我们时，它有一万种人类甚至都意识不到的隐蔽手段。

“最紧迫的研究课题，是如何在数学上设计这些新生命，让它们‘不想’去接管世界。”

这是亲手把火种带给人类的普罗米修斯，在悬崖边向全人类发出的最后通牒。
47 分钟每一秒都充满思维的阻尼感，建议所有对 AI 未来还心存侥幸的朋友，找一个安静的深夜，彻底把它看一遍。 https://t.co/mkk98LlMR1

text:
We are releasing AutoResearchExam, a benchmark on open-ended machine learning and engineering tasks. Our benchmark covers seven research areas including model training, data curation, AI safety and interpretability.

https://t.co/Rho35ULgS5

In each task, we give agents 24 hours with a CPU or GPU machine to develop and improve their solutions through experiments and feedback. We measure both speed and quality with a combined score. Our benchmark has a unique feature: testing if agents create improvements that hold up on data they never see. We find that AI research agents often overfit as they try to improve. 

We see an interesting head-to-head comparison at the frontier: Astra starts the strongest and holds the lead for up to 19 hours but Fable 5.1 catches up and gets the top performing spot in the final hours. 

Qwen3.8 Max, Gemini 3.8 Flash and Grok 4.6 all sit on the cost-performance Pareto frontier, giving strong options at lower API budgets.

Anthropic's Opus and Fable retain nearly all their validation performance on hidden tests, with gaps of 1.1% and 2.9%. Astra's improvement over Sol extends to generalization too, with that gap falling from 6.9% to 1.7%. (1/n)

text:
Todd Beamer died a father, husband, and hero.

Todd: Hello… Operator… listen to me. I can’t speak very loud. This is an emergency. I’m a passenger on a United flight to San Francisco. Our plane has been hijacked.

Lisa: I understand. Can they see you?

Todd: No. There are three that we know of. They have knives — razor knives, like box cutters. Someone announced from the cockpit there was a bomb. It sounded fake.

Lisa: Your name?Todd: Todd Beamer. United Flight 93.Todd: They killed one passenger in first class. They forced most of us back. Fourteen of us here. Five flight attendants. The guy with the bomb ordered us to sit on the floor.

Lisa: Are you okay?

Todd: We’re going down… wait. No. We’re leveling off. We changed directions. We’re flying east again.

Todd: A guy named Jeremy called his wife. She told him two planes hit the World Trade Center. Lisa, is that true?

Lisa: I have to tell you the truth. It’s very bad. Both towers are gone. A third plane hit the Pentagon. Our country is under attack. I’m afraid your plane may be part of their plan.

Todd: Oh God. Lisa, will you do something for me? Call my wife and my kids. Promise me you’ll call.

Lisa: I promise.

Todd: Our home number is… You have the same name as my wife. Lisa. We’ve been married ten years. She’s pregnant with our third child. Tell her I love her. I’ll always love her. We have two boys — David, he’s 3, and Andrew, he’s 1. Tell them their daddy loves them and he is so proud of them. The baby is due January 12th. I saw an ultrasound. We still don’t know if it’s a girl or a boy.

Lisa: I’ll tell them. I promise, Todd.(Lisa patches in the FBI.)

Agent: Todd, your plane is on a course for Washington. Best guess is the White House or the Capitol.

Todd: I understand. I’ll be back.

Todd: Everyone knows this isn’t a normal hijacking. We have decided we will not be pawns in their plot.

Lisa: What are you going to do?

Todd: Four of us are going to rush the one with the bomb. Then the cockpit. A stewardess is getting boiling water. We’ll take them out.

Todd: Would you pray with me?They pray the Lord’s Prayer. Then: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for thou art with me.

Todd: God help me. Jesus help me.Are you guys ready? Let’s Roll.

Windows 11's big September 2026 Update is causing major issues, and Microsoft has admitted that it's aware of three problems while it's investigating a fourth bug.

1. Anthropic says Windows 11 KB5124008 broke Claude Cowork's features. Microsoft later admitted that the update indeed has a bug causing issues with Claude and other Linux-based VMs.

2. Microsoft confirmed that some audio devices won't work, or the volume will remain at zero.

3. Remote Desktop Services might stop responding after Sept. 2026 security update.

4. Microsoft is also investigating reports of explorer exe crashes, particularly affecting enterprises.

5. Our findings suggest File History backups are now broken after the Windows Update.

6. We're also seeing reports of GPU issues on AMD systems.

Microsoft is investigating multiple reports and has promised to release a fix soon.

Windows 11 September Update bumps PCs to Build 26200.9445, and adds features like the movable taskbar, resizable Start menu, Bing-free search, faster File Explorer, and more.
